rationale: The translation accurately captures the n+1 Lagrange construction, distinct fixed nodes, unrestricted evaluation point, nonzero exact interpolant value, componentwise relative perturbation model, relative scalar output error, closed-form condition expression, and lower bound. It nevertheless omits two parts of the selected result: the universal finite-perturbation inequality and the sign-aligned attaining perturbation. Those omissions make the expressed result incomplete. Adjudication is additionally required because the paper passage does not explicitly specify the scalar domain or mark the limit as one-sided, whereas the translation fixes real scalars and a right-hand limit.
